title: Re-enable pesto IPv6 forwarding E2E tests after pasta release
body:
The pesto IPv6 port forwarding tests are currently skipped because pasta's local-mode IPv6 forwarding requires an unreleased upstream patch (https://archives.passt.top/passt-dev/20260722232639.1105561-1-sbrivio@redhat.com/).
Once a pasta release ships with this fix, remove the `Skip()` calls in `test/e2e/run_networking_test.go` for:
- Source IP pasta IPv6 tests (IPv6, IPv6 explicit HostIP, IPv6 different ports)
- Dual-stack network IPv4 and IPv6 port forwarding with pasta [Serial]
- Dual-stack same port IPv4 and IPv6 route to different containers
- Multiple port mappings on different addresses
- Different host and container ports on dual-stack network with pesto
